note: Draft vocabulary for solvent recovery equipment. Codes, aliases and descriptions are illustrative, not taken from any real company's BOMs.

categories.vessel: Tanks and columns that hold or boil the solvent
categories.heat_transfer: Equipment that adds or removes heat
categories.vacuum: Equipment that lowers pressure so solvents boil at lower temperatures
categories.residue: Equipment that removes what is left after boiling
categories.controls: Electrical panels, PLCs and operator screens
categories.safety: Equipment that makes the unit safe in flammable areas

modules.name: Batch still, 200 L
modules.description: Heated vessel that boils dirty solvent. The vapour leaves for the condenser and the contaminants stay behind as residue.

modules.name: Batch still, 400 L
modules.description: Larger version of the batch still, for higher waste volumes per batch.

modules.name: Fractionation column
modules.description: Tall column that separates a solvent mixture by boiling point. Used when very high purity is needed, for example battery-grade NMP.

modules.name: Reboiler
modules.description: Heat exchanger at the bottom of a column that keeps the liquid boiling in continuous systems.

modules.name: Feed tank
modules.description: Holding tank that supplies waste solvent to a continuous system at a steady rate.

modules.name: Shell-and-tube condenser
modules.description: Cools the solvent vapour back into clean liquid. Cooling water or chiller fluid flows on the other side of the tubes.

modules.name: Explosion-proof chiller
modules.description: Refrigeration unit that supplies cold fluid to the condenser when the site has no cooling water. Usually bought in, not designed.

modules.name: Liquid ring vacuum pump
modules.description: Lowers the pressure inside the still so solvents boil at a lower temperature. Needed for high-boiling solvents and heat-sensitive ones.

modules.name: Sludge discharge pump
modules.description: Pumps thick residue out of the still automatically, instead of an operator removing a bag liner by hand.

modules.name: Standard control panel
modules.description: Electrical panel with a small PLC and touchscreen, for units in general-purpose or Div 2 areas.

modules.name: Control panel for hazardous areas
modules.description: Control panel built and certified for a flammable (Class I Div 1) area, usually paired with a purge enclosure.

modules.name: Large control panel
modules.description: Larger PLC system for continuous plants with many sensors, valves and control loops.

modules.name: Remote operator screen
modules.description: Operator touchscreen mounted away from the machine, for example in a control room.

modules.name: Purge enclosure system
modules.description: Keeps the electrical enclosure filled with clean air or gas at a slight positive pressure, so flammable vapour cannot get in. A common way to put electronics in a Div 1 area.
